cards.title: The Builder Fires Its Own Arm
items: At ticket scope, the Builder fires the arm from inside its own closed loop
HEAD resolves to the head under review — there is nowhere else it could resolve to
No gate worktree, no broker to kill: none of the spec-scope apparatus applies

cards.title: What The Arm Wins At
items: Internal inconsistency against the project's own standard
The author reads the ticket; the arm reads the repository
One pass found a real deadlock the code pass had just added

cards.title: Failover Is Recorded, Not Hidden
items: Codex unavailable or out of quota means the arm DID NOT RUN, recorded as such
The exit code is never trustworthy — only the output file is
The receipt is an empty commit whose body names the pass that ran
